children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Tuesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.2% lower at C$1.3925 to the greenback, or 71.81 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3898 to 1.3929.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 1.2 basis points to 3.95%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.9957%.
futures rose 37 cents to $101.76 a barrel on Tuesday.
